state.context:
INCIDENT #4471 - checkout-api elevated 5xx

--- TOPOLOGY ---
- checkout-api runs in three regions: us-east, eu-west, ap-south.
- Each region has its own isolated Postgres primary. There is no cross-region database replication, and schema migrations are applied per region as part of a regional deploy.
- A second service, refund-worker, runs in all three regions and writes to the same regional `orders` table as checkout-api. refund-worker deploys on its own schedule and has been on build rw-88 in all three regions for eleven days, unchanged.
- Connection pooling: Both services connect to Postgres via a shared local PgBouncer instance in each region using transaction-level pooling mode.
- Read/Write Split: POST /checkout writes directly to `orders` and sets `currency`. POST /refunds enqueues asynchronous refund jobs processed by refund-worker, which executes `UPDATE orders SET status = 'refunded' ...` and `INSERT INTO orders ...` for replacement/adjustment records.

--- RELEASE TIMELINE (all times UTC, same day) ---
- 09:02  v412 deployed to us-east only, as a canary. Application code changes only; no schema changes.
- 11:30  v413 deployed to us-east and eu-west. v413 contains application code changes AND migration 0091.
- ap-south received neither deploy and remains on v411.
- Migration 0091 adds a column `currency` to `orders`, declared NOT NULL with no default value.
- checkout-api v413 sets `currency` explicitly on every insert it performs. refund-worker build rw-88 does not set `currency` on its inserts.
- 11:33  First automated refund batch triggered by periodic scheduled job following the 11:30 deployment.

--- OBSERVED ---
- us-east 5xx rate: flat at the 0.02% baseline from 09:02 through 11:33.
- us-east 5xx begins climbing at 11:34, reaching 4.1% by 11:41.
- eu-west 5xx begins climbing at 11:34, reaching 3.8% by 11:41.
- ap-south 5xx: flat at the 0.02% baseline throughout, no change at any point.
- Every failing request is a POST /refunds. POST /checkout succeeds normally in all three regions.
- Logs on the failing requests: `ERROR: null value in column "currency" of relation "orders" violates not-null constraint`, with the originating statement attributed to refund-worker build rw-88.
- Request volume, instance count, CPU, and memory are unchanged in all three regions across the whole window.
- Database lock contention and CPU metrics remain at normal operational baselines across all regions.
